useCase: Detecting AI生成的 smooth regions, texture 异常, and information-theoretic irregularities
mechanism: Computes Shannon 熵 for overlapping image blocks and builds an 熵 heatmap. AI生成的 images often show unnaturally uniform 熵 分布s compared to the natural variation found in authentic photographs.
accuracy: 中等 - 70-80%（作为其他方法的补充信号）
name: 熵分析
parameters: 块大小: 16x16, Overlap: 75%, Channels: grayscale + per-channel, Metrics: local 熵, 熵 方差, min/max ratio
description: 测量 information 熵 跨 image blocks 以检测 regions with abnormal randomness or uniformity, common in AI生成的 content.

references.title: Shannon, C.E. (1948). A Mathematical Theory of Communication. Bell System Technical Journal.
Lyu, S. & Farid, H. (2006). Steganalysis Using Higher-Order Image Statistics. IEEE TIFS.
Fridrich, J., et al. (2001). Detection of copy-move forgery in digital images. DFRWS.

strengths:
• Information-theoretic foundation
• Reveals unnaturally smooth AI regions
• 适用于任何图像格式
• Provides spatial 熵 map for localization
limitations:
• Simple textures naturally have low 熵
• Heavy compression reduces 熵 variation
• Studio/controlled photos may appear uniform
• Standalone 准确度 is moderate
